tagline: Husun al-Ma'rifa: a team quiz war on a hex map
brief: A host-run team quiz game in Arabic: right answers pay for battalions, every attack is a question, and losing your capital knocks you out. Played on a dark war-room table in navy and brass.
criteria: Says both halves of the name (fortress + knowledge), avoids quiz clichés (question marks, light bulbs), holds at 16 px, works in one colour on navy and parchment.

concepts.name: Book Wall
concepts.idea: An open book whose page tops are battlements: knowledge is the wall.
rationale: Draws the name itself: حصون (fortress) + المعرفة (knowledge)
Two-tone pages keep the open book legible down to 16 px
Brass on navy is the game's own war-room palette
Kufic wordmark (Reem Kufi) echoes the square battlements

recommendation: Book Wall: one picture that states the name, distinct from quiz-game clichés, and at home on the game's navy-and-brass screen.
next_steps: Drop the web icons into the game's index.html
Use the horizontal lockup on the setup screen header
Run a trademark search before any public release
